items.title: 8.1.5 Advanced Information Retrieval Techniques (search engines, keywords, Boolean operators, advanced search features) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of advanced retrieval (PDF 197-198).

items: Mo-assar search queries: khaas hon; 'traditional Pakistani recipes' 'recipes' se behtar nataij deta hai.
Mo-assar keywords: mauzoo ke sab se aham alfaaz; sirf 'farming' ki bajaye 'organic farming'.
Boolean operators: AND dono alfaaz shamil (agriculture AND irrigation), OR koi bhi (crops OR vegetables), NOT ek lafz nikalta hai (farming NOT pesticides).
Advanced search features: tareekh, jagah waghaira se filter; Pakistan ki taleemi policy ki taaza khabron ke liye nataij pichhle saal tak mehdood karein.

blocks.alt: Oopar: ek doosre par charhe dairon ke teen jore. agriculture AND irrigation mein sirf mushtarak hissa rangeen; crops OR vegetables mein dono daire rangeen; farming NOT pesticides mein sirf farming ka woh hissa rangeen jo pesticides se bahar hai. Neeche baen: online research ki paanch qismein. Neeche daen: digital literacy ke paanch ajza.
blocks.caption: Boolean search, online research ki qismein aur digital literacy (topic 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: AND sirf woh pages deta hai jin mein dono alfaaz hon, yaani dono dairon ka mushtarak hissa, to talash tang hoti hai; OR woh pages deta hai jin mein koi bhi lafz ho, yaani dono daire poore, to talash wasee hoti hai; NOT woh pages deta hai jin mein pehla lafz ho magar doosra nahi, mushtarak hissa kaat kar. Online research aam, ilmi, market, fact-checking ya sehat ki ho sakti hai. Digital literacy technology istemal, talash, maakhaz ki parakh, mawad banane aur mehfooz aur private rehne ka majmooa hai.

blocks.text: Kitab batati hai ke duniya ki aadhi se zyada abadi internet istemal karti hai, is liye achhi online research taqatwar maharat hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa Boolean operator lafz nikalta hai (MCQ 2)? Khaas keywords kyun istemal karein (short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: (c) NOT. Khaas keywords search engine ko theek theek batate hain ke aap kya chahte hain, to nataij mutalliqa hote aur ghair mutalliqa pages chhantne mein kam waqt lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: khaas keywords se mauzoo par talash, teen maakhaz, un ka aitbaar aur links ke saath khulasa. Achhe khulase mein kya ho?
blocks.explanation: Apne alfaaz mein bunyadi haqaiq, har maakhaz ke motabar (ya na hone) ki wajah, aur har maakhaz ka link.

items: Behtar talash: khaas queries aur keywords, Boolean AND/OR/NOT, advanced filters.
